name: Playwright + Chromium
description: Bakes Chromium's root-only OS dependencies plus one browser revision as a warm cache. The revision Playwright actually launches is set by the repository's own pin; a mismatch is fetched on demand from the allowlisted Playwright CDN.

version.description: Playwright version to bake. Only decides which browser revision is pre-cached — a repository pinning a different Playwright fetches its own from the CDN.
